findings.title: Migration crashes when no embed category was explicitly configured
findings.body: This query can return no rows when `embed_category` has no persisted site-setting value or its value does not match a category. Indexing `[0]['id']` then raises, aborting the migration and preventing upgrades on those installations. Handle the missing result and use the uncategorized category as the fallback before reading the ID.
